tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shrī badzra kī la ya u pa sā dha kā pra kā sha a mṛ ta pra bha wan nā ma bi ha ra tisma// ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen bsgrub kyi gsal byed bdud rtsis 'od can zhes bya ba la sngags 'chang chen po'i mchan gnang ba bzhugs so// shrī badzra ku ma ra kro dha ya na mā mye haṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi 'phrin las drag po'i sku/ /rdo rje gsum gyi zhal ldan pha rol phyin/ /phyag gi yal gas rab brjid dbang sngon mdangs/ /khro bo'i dbang po mchog la gus btud nas/ /de nyid sgrub thabs 'khrul med brgyud pa'i gsungs/ /zhal gyi bdud rtsi las rnyed bsnyen bsgrub tshul/ /gsal bar ston pa'i man ngag 'dir bshad kyis/ /don gnyer shes ldan gus pa'i tshul gyi nyon/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu sa lugs su grags pa 'di la/ rtsa ba rdo rje khros pa'i rgyud kyi le'us las zur du phyung ba/ phur pa rtsa dum gyi rgyud chung 'di nyid la brten nas slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i dkyil chog rdo rje las rim rtsa 'grel nas ji ltar bshad pa bzhin/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis phur ba'i bsnyen bsgrub kyi tho yig mdzad pa gzhir bzhag nas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyis sgrub thabs che 'bring chung ngu gsum mdzad pa las/ rgyun du nyams su len pa dang / dus dang / grangs kyi bsnyen pa byed pa'i tshe sgrub thabs chung ba 'di nyid don tshang la nyams su len bde bas/ de'i tshul dkyus su mi gsal ba cung zad brjod na/ thog mar gang du bsnyen pa bya ba'i sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' ba'i bsgrub khang bla ma gong ma yid ches pa rnams kyi bzhugs gnas yin pa'am/ yang na 'dre srin gdug pa can gnas pa'i sa ma yin par/ rang gi mdun du bla ma yi dam gyi rten gang rigs dang / khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i sku lugs ma'am/ bris sku rab gnas can gyi mdun du/ 'di'i gtor ma stod zur gsum/

smad zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba la/ ched du bsad pa ma yin pa'i sha khrag gis brgyan pa dbus su bzhag de'i dbus su bandha lcang lo can gyi nang du rakta ……khrag ma 'byor na chang la sha dmar po btab pa/ gtor ma'i g.yas su thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du sman phud gtsang ma/ de rnams kyi mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa ……me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ phreng du bshams/ rang nyid shar ram lhor kha phyogs pas stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ nam mkhar bla ma yi dam chos bsrung rnams mngon sum ltar bzhugs par mos nas skyabs 'gro'i khyad par bzhi ……bsdu na skyabs 'gro'i yul bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsam/ skyabs su 'gro ba pha ma rigs drug gi skyabs 'gro byed par bsam/ rgyu 'jigs dang snying po/ dus sangs rgyas ma thob bar ram/ gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar gsol btab la/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /……skyabs 'gro gzhung bzhin nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam byas pa'i rjes su/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/…… rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum brten pa'i zhing gyur las/

/gnyis med yid kyi skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyi rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i gegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yid rang / /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/ /dgos pa gsum gyi lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rab bsgrangs pa'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /shu n+ya ta'i ……oṃ ma ha shu n+ya tā dzñān badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ rjes su phyi nang snod bcud kyi bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje gzhon nu sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ badzra añdza li hūm̐/ badzra bhandha/ badzra añdza li dzaḥ yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams nas khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa mang po byung ste dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu brdungs la/ phaṭa gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/……gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /song shig lha min lha yang rung / /nga la bar chad byed pa'i bdud/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos/ /ces pa nas/ kī la ya dang khro bcu'i sngags brjod/ hūm̐ khro bo rnams rang ……oṃ badzra kī li kī li ya sarba bighnān bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha nī la daṇṭa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ya mān ta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ badzra kro dha arya a tsa la hūm̐ bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya gṛ ba hūm̐ hū lu hū lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha trai lo kya bi dza ya hūm̐ bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐ spho ṭa spho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ gi thugs khar thim/ hūm̐ las mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs byung / sna bug nas thon/ g.yas nas bskor bas bgegs bskrad de rwa bar gyur/ hūm̐ nga yi dkyil 'khor brtan bya'i phyir/……hūm̐ nga yi dkyil 'khor brtan bya'i phyir/ /khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i/ /mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin bsrungs/ /oṃ badzra a yu dha rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs nas a yu dha rakṣa'i bar brjod/ sems kyis snying ga'i hūm̐ las rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/ rgya gram/ dbyug tho rnams spros nas 'og tu de dag gi sa gzhi/ logs su rwa ba/ steng du gur la sogs par gyur par bsam ste/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur rgyab sbyar mthe chung sbrel mthe bos srin mdzub mnan/ gung mdzub gnyis gyen du sbreng ba'i phyag rgya g.yon du bskor zhing bgegs bskrad/ phyag rgya g.yas su bskor bas rwa gur du gyur par bsam la/…… rdo rje nyal mo kha sbyar ba la mtheb mdzub gnyis rtse sprad pa rin po che'i rnam par byas pa dang / srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas/ dmyal ba'i sa gzhi yan chod kyi/ log par blta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ oṃ badzra re dza tiṣṭha tsakra rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa dang / rwa ba de rnams las 'phros pa'i me 'od kyi bgegs thams cad bsregs par bsam zhing / thal mo rgyab sbyar ba'i sor mo gzhan bsnol mthe bong rtse sprad pa dang / phyi rol kun tu 'od 'phros pas/ /bdud dpung nges par bsreg byed pa/

/sa dang mkha' kun khyab pa yis/ /'bar ba me yis phung por gyur/ /oṃ badzra dzwa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ sngags tshar ……gong gi badzra a yu ṣa rakṣa tshar gnyis brjod pa'i rting ma la phaṭa bzhag pa/ gnyis brjod bsrung ba'i 'khor lo shin tu brtan zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ zhes pa nas/ me ri'i sngags kyi bar mngon rtogs rgyas pa bzhin ngag tu brjod cing lus kyi phyag rgya/ sems kyi dmigs pa gsal 'debs pa sogs bya ste/ mtshams bcad cing bsrung 'khor bsgom pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can bsrung ma'i tshogs dang bsrung 'khor gyi nang / mdun gyi nam mkhar badzra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru ……na mo gu ru bhyaḥ na mo badzra kī li kī la ya maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā re bhyaḥ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyi bzung / /sogs nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs shlau ka gcig po tshar gsum/ mdun gyi tshogs kyi zhing de dag thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang gi snying khar thim/ yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje dang / byin rlabs bsdus nas bdag dang dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su thim pas/ byin gyis rlabs par gyur/ a la la hoḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de'i dus kyi dmigs pa ni/ snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi rnam pas mdun gyi nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa thams cad yab yum mnyam par sbyar bas byang chub kyi sems dkar dmar 'dres pa 'od kyi rnam pa can sbyor mtshams nas byung bas rang dang gnas la thim byin gyis rlabs par bsam/

rdzas byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ sman raka gtor ma rnams mngon rtogs rgyas pa ltar bsnyen phur byin gyis rlabs pa'i bar bya'o/……oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐/ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang gi thugs ka nas raṃ dmar po spros pa'i mes bdud rtsi dang gtor ma'i gnod la reg pas mi gtsang ba bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pa'i chus bkrus te dag par bya/ bhrum̐ spros pas bandha 'bar ba'i snod chen por gyur/ oṃ spros pas mchod rdzas rnams 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyi mi khyab pas gang bar gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me'i steng du kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyid bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs par/ hūm̐ oṃ trāṃ hrīḥ a las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga'i ngo bor gyur/ rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ rdzas rnams 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa/ hūm̐ oṃ swā ā hā las phyag mtshan lngar gyur/ hūm̐ badzra traka oṃ dzi na dzika swā ratna dhrika ā a ro lika hā prañdzā dhṝka ces brjod pas he ru ka yab yum bcur gyur/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ ces brjod pas sbyor ba'i mes 'od du zhu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ du gyur/ de las 'od 'phros pas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi bkug nas bstim/ 'og gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ ces brgya rtsa brgyad dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ te dzo ba linta ba la bā te gu hya siddhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥtha/ ces bdun gyi byin gyis rlabs/ rakta'i snod a las thod pa yangs par ra las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag las byung ba'i bdud rtsir gyur byin gyis rlabs la/ ma suryā maṇḍa la ra spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ 'di man tshar bdun/……oṃ āḥhūm̐ mahā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥtha/

ces pas byin gyis rlabs so/ /yang hūm̐ pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ badzra ki li ki la ya zhes brjod pas/ phur pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i lus la khro bo bcus brgyan par gyur bsgom pa la/ oṃ badzra ki li kī li ya sarba bighnān bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ dngos gzhi ni/ dang po rang gi sems ma bcos pa stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral ba chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / stong pa nyid des 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab cing / de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams la rab tu brtse ba'i snying rje bsgom pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / thabs shes rab gnyis med rang rig gsal la ma 'gags pa de yi ge hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu gyur pa rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'i rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin te/ oṃ mahā ……oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā gong bzhin/ oṃ dharma dha tu badzra swa bha wā ātma ko3haṃ/ rdo rje khro bo zhes sdang gcod/ /mtshon chen sngon po cher 'bar ma/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang / /snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/ /hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las raṃ chad snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bsregs/ yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus skyon thams cad dag par byas/ shu n+ya ta nas skyon thams cad dag par byas/ zhes pa'i bar dang / e/ yaṃ/ baṃ/ raṃ/ laṃ/ raṃ/ kaṃ e/ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ e las mkha' dbyings sogs nas/ dbus su ……e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil/ /yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ /de steng baṃ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ /raṃ las me byung bskyod pa de yi byed/ /laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ /de steng rakta'i rgya mtsho'i rba rlabs 'khrug/ keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud rdo rjes spras/

/zhes pa nas gtso bo yab yum bskyed cing ye shes pa dgug gzhug gi bar mngon rtogs bsdus pa ltar bya/……dzaḥpa padma maṇḍa la/ ma sūrya maṇḍa la/ a tsant+ra maṇḍa la/ ma hā de bā dzaḥ u ma de wī dzaḥ padma nyi ma dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin hūm̐ de bab pa las 'od 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur bsdus te 'od du zhu ba/ rang rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur gyur pa ni/ hūm̐ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ gdan steng bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang / /me dpung 'bar ba rtse gsum bsnams/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis phyag gi bsnams/ /mtha' gnyis phur 'dril sku che rags/ /mche gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar/ /ral pa khams pa gyen du brdzes/ /glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stag gi pags pa'i 'og lpags can/ /dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul rgyan gyis/ /dbu rgyan se ral sked chings dang / /phyag dang zhabs gnyis rnam par spras/ /thod skam lnga yi dbu la brgyan/ /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rakta zhag dang thal chen gyis/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs nas/ /dbang phyug kha phub mgo bo dang / /u ma'i nu ma rab brdzis shing / /ye shes me dpung dbus na bzhugs/ /rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched/ /skra nyi khri chig stong / ba spu bye ba phrag phyed bzhi la sogs pa thams cad kyang rdo rje gzhon nu rang dang 'dra ba go mtshams med pas bltams par gyur/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bcad cing mnan pa nyid min te/ /phung po rdo rje'i bdag nyid de/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/

/bhrūm̐ bi mā na ma sūrya hūm̐ dzñā na satwa kṛṣṇa shu ka pañtsa badzra hūm̐/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dipta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stob/ /gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /rus pa'i rgyan lngas sku la brgyan/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas/ /sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyi brgyan/ /rakta zhag dang thal chen gyis/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon brkyangs bskum gyis/ /yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i rigs 'dzin rnams/ /'khor ba rdo rjer sgrub par mdzod/ /oṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇi hūm̐/ 'khor ba rdo rje phur pa'i lha/ /ye shes khro bo grub par mdzod/ /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri bā ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badzra yakṣi ṇi hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badzra bhai ra be hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta hūm̐ baṃ/ oṃ badzra mā ra ṇi hūm̐ hoḥ sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs pa'i skabs su/ dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying khar oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam nas/ de dag las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i 'bru gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas lus ngag yid rdo rje gsum du gyur par bsams la/ sangs rgyas kun gyis ye shes sku/ /rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ /sku yi gter du bdag bskyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ka ya badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gsung / rdo rje༞ chos kyi༞ 'bar ba'i khro bo'i༞ gsung gi gter du༞ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta waka badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes thugs/ /rdo rje༞ chos kyi༞

'bar ba'i༞ thugs kyi gter du bdag bskyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3haṃ/ yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas khro bo rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ dbang bskur bar gsol ba gdab par bsam zhing / /thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas 'phrin las rdzogs par mdzod/ /dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol zhig /ces brjod/ de nas ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ spyi bor he ru ka rigs lnga yab yum gyi dbang bskur bar bsam zhing / oṃ badzra shrī re he ru ka badzra kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐/ oṃ buddha shrī he ru ka buddha kro dhi shwa ri oṃ/ oṃ ratna shrī he ru ka ratna kro dhi shwa ri trāṃ/ oṃ padma shrī he ru ka padma kro dhi shwa ri hrīḥ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dha shwa ri ā/…… sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /sogs sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin bya/ dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'ang bya'o/ /phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor ni/ e spha ra ṇa phaṭa/ zhes brjod phur gdan e las gru gsum mthing nag 'bar bas bskyed/ sarba sha truṃ ……bighnān dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sogs brjod dus gru gsum gyi dbus su dgra bgegs thams cad bkug par bsam/ oṃ badzra kro ta ……kuṇḍa li hūm̐/ tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la sarba bighnan rakṣaḥ a mṛ ta sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ mdun gyi phur pa la gu gul gyis bdug cing / yungs kar gyis brab/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ gcig chad pa mdun du sras mchog zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dang ldan pa'i skur bsam la/ skye med rnam dag ……skye med rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid las/ /skye ba'i chos 'phrul 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum ma lus kun/

/sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /srid pa rdo rje phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /zhes pas chos sku las longs sku he ru kar bzhengs par bskul ba/ mkha' nas longs sku yab yum sprul par bsam ste/ phyag mtshan gtso bo dang 'dra'o/ /de nas longs sku las/ sprul sku sras mchog sprul par gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir/ hūm̐ dbus kyi mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /rdo rje 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /zhe sdang bdud 'dul khro rgyal dbyings nas bzhengs/ /srid pa rdo rje phur pa bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /sogs nas/ mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /badzra kī li kī la ya dzaḥzhes pa'i bar brjod pas sras mchog smad phur bu dbal gyi rnam pa la/ stod zhal gsum phyag drug par bsam ste/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya ……sarba bighnān bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas longs sku las/ sprul sku sras mchog sku stod khro bo zhal gsum phyag drug smad phur bu'i rnam pa can du bsam/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ sked par hrīḥ rtse mor phaṭa/ ces pas sku gsung thugs byin gyis rlabs/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa bstim/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka badzra kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐ sogs lngas gong bzhin dbang bskur/ ma surya maṇḍa la/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍa la/ hūm̐ āḥ oṃ hūm̐/ swa/ ā/ hā/ saṃ/ maṃ/ laṃ/ paṃ/ taṃ/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ badzra añdza li hūm̐/ badzra bandha/ badzra añdza li dzaḥ sogs nas/ phur pa chu srin rnam grol gyi phyag rgyas bzung nas/ dīpta tsakra phur pa'i lha/……mthing nag gcer bu ral pa can/ /sku stod khro bo chen po la/ /zhal gsum phyag kyang drug pa ste/ /dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs/ lte ba man chad sku yi cha/ /utpal sngon po'i 'dab 'dra ba/

/'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrig pa'i 'od/ /lcags kyi phur bu zur gsum pa/ /drag por gyur pa'i phur pa ste/ /btab na lha yang brlag par 'gyur/ /gnod byed bgegs la smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa nas/ /dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs/ /zhes pa'i bar dang / lte ba man chad sogs la phur bu sgril nas/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la sarba bighnān bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa/……spyi gtsug oṃ dipta tsakra kī li kī la sarba bighnān bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa/……dpral ba/ oṃ dīpta ratna kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa/……rna ltag g.yas/ oṃ dīpta padma kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ padma a bhi ṣiñtsa/……ltag pa/ oṃ dīpta karma kī li kī la ya rba bighnān bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa/……rna ltag g.yon/ oṃ sarba tathā ga ta kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/……dpral ba/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wā ka a bhi ṣi ñtsa āḥ……mgrin pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ snying kha/……sngags rnams brjod dus phur mgo spyi gtsug dpral ba/ rna ltag g.yas/ ltag pa/ rna ltag g.yon dang / kā ya sogs brjod dus dpral mgrin snying gar reg pas khro bo khro mo thams cad kyi phrin las bdag la 'dus par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas rdo rje gzhon nu lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi dkyil 'khor la dam can bsrung ma'i tshogs kyi bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar ……badzra sa mā dzaḥbyon par bsam zhing / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang / /sprul pa yang sprul bka' stod bsrung ma'i tshogs/ /glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs nas/ /kī la ya yi dngos grub rtsal du gsol/ /oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dang / zhabs bsil gdan dbul sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin byas ……yang dag don du dag mod kyang /

/'gro ba kun gyi don slad du/ /phyag dang zhabs ni bsil nas kyang / /rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ra hasta pu tsa pā tyaṃ sri tītstsha badzra ā sa na tiṣṭhantu/ ces pa'angazhabs bsil gdan dbul/ /bde bar gshegs so khro rgyal gtso/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes kyi/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ /na māḥsarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba tha khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ ces mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod/ rjes sgeg 'phreng ……sgeg 'phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog ma/ /mar me dri ma nyer spyod rol mo'i sgra/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams bskang nas/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can bsrung ma la/ /rnam dag blo yi mos blos bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shig kī la ya yi dngos grub rtsol/ /badzra lā sye hūm̐/ badzra mā le traṃ/ badzra girti hrīḥ badzra nīrti āḥ badzra dhu pe hūm̐/ badzra puṣpe trāṃ/ badzra ā lo ke hrīḥ badzra gandhe aḥ oṃ badzra puṣpe ā/ oṃ badzra dhū pe ā hūm̐/ oṃ badzra a lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ne wi dye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shabta ā hūm̐/ sogs kyi phyi mchod/ nang mchod rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba yi/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /rgyud lnga sems can kun sgrol phyir/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/ /ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po/ /thugs dam dbyings nyid bskul ba'i phyir/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi ngang nyid du/ /bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes te kun tu dges mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /na māḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī……sogs nas ka pā la bandha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin bya/ rgyal ba kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /rigs 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsis dam rdzas mnyes mchod 'bul/ /thugs rje che dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ 'jigs byed chen po khro bo yab yum bcu/ /sprul pa'i phra thabs yab yum nyi shu dang / /sgo ma bzhi dang sras mchog phur bu'i tshogs/ /rnam dag sogs/ phyi nang mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thams cad dang / /ging chen bco brgyad ging phran 'bum sde dang / /dpag bsam shing lha re ma ti rnams la/ /rnam dag༞ shwa na mu kha bdag nyid chen mo dang / /bse yi lha mo phyogs bcu'i rnal 'byor tshogs/ /dam bsrung mched lcam bstan ma bcu gnyis la/ /rnam dag༞ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du khā hi/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi༞ chos sku kun tu bzang po'i༞ longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'i༞ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas༞ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ khyad par chos skyongs bsrung ma rnams kyi zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ rang gi lce la nang mchod bzhag nas/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i/ /rigs 'dzin bdag cag thams cad la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /kā ya siddhi oṃ/ wāka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ 'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /padmo la ni rdo rje zhugs/ /bdag nyid mchod pas mnyes par byos/ /sa ma ya ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ rā go a nu rā ga nā mi bodhi tsitta/ mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas chen po ste/ bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bza' dang bca' dang btung dang bgo /longs spyod lnga ldan thams cad ni/ /dkyil 'khor la yang dkyil 'khor thim/ /a la la ste dkyil 'khor thim/ /dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā badzra ā be sha ya/

ā be sha ya/ prā be sha ya/ mahā su kha pra titstsha ho/ pra ti grihṇa khā hi/……'khril ba'i mchod chen sogs gsang mchod dang / de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa gnyis mngon rtogs rgyas bsdus gang rung ltar bya/ bsgral mchod ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo khro mo phra thabs/ sgo ma sras mchog dam can gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros nas dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad bsgral bar bsam zhing / dam tshig chen po nas ……dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ /sprul pa chen po'i dus la babs/ /pho nya chen po'i dus la bab/ /bdag nyid chen po'i dus la bab/ /sa bdag rgyal mo'i dus la bab/ /khyi yi gdong can༞ bsgral bar bya ba'i dus la bab/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bzhin du/ /rigs 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni/ /gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ /khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyi/ /yud tsam gyis ni de bkug nas/ /mngon gcod tshul gyis bsgral ba dang / /lus ngag phye mar mdzad nas kyang / /sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ /oṃ laṃ/ hūm̐/ laṃ/ satwaṃ bha ni mo haṃ ghā ta ya bha ga wān hrīḥṣṭiḥbi kri badzra hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐/ badzra kī li kī la ya/ dza hūm̐ baṃ ho/ sarba bighnān badzra kī li kī la ya phaṭa/ kha taṃ kha taṃ kha taṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badzra yakṣa kro dha kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ hā hā/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ phaṭa phaṭa/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyi bar bsdus pa bzhin byas rjes/ rakta'i ……dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus kyi mchod par bsam la/ he ru ka yi gnas bcu dang / /dur khrood chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /dpal chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ /dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru/ /zhing chen gsar rnying ri rwar bcas/ /dmar gyi arghaṃ rgya mtshor bskyil/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyi/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā sa ma ya rakta sa mu dra kha kha khā hi khā hi/

hrī da ya pi pa thā hūm̐ phaṭa/ nga ni za byed chen po ste/ /khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang / /'dul dka' mtha' dag 'dul ba'i phyir/ /sha rus la sogs za bar bya/ /nga ni khrag 'thung chen po ste/ /dmar gyi mchod pa rgya mtshor bskyil/ /'khor ba'i drwa ba gcod pa'i phyir/ /'khor gyi phra men tshogs rnams kyi/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā ru dhi ra wā hi/ ma hā maṃ sa khā hi/ mahā ma ta ka khā hi/ mahā ma a gi khā hi/ de thams cad la gtor ma'i steng du rakta bsgrengs/ rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi ljags las byung ba'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phros/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi rab brgyan te/ /thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka i daṃ/ puṣpaṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gandhaṃ/ ba linta pra titstsha hoḥ gṛhṇa kha hi/ badzra yakṣa kro dha/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sngags 'di gsum mam bdun gyi gtor ma dbul/ mchod pa ni/ rgyas bsdus gang rung skabs dang mthun par bya zhing / gtor ma'i mchod pa dang / bstod ……bstod pa ni/ sgeg cing dpa' dang mi sdug tshul ston zhing / /rgod dang gshe dang 'jig su rung ba dang / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba la sogs pa/ /gar dgu'i rol mdzad rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /e ka dza ti gu hya gsang ba'i yum/ /hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang dmigs bu'i mgo /rnam rgyal sgeg mo stag dang bya rgod mgo /dbyug sngon sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo /gshin rje dur khrod shwa ba 'ug pa'i mgo /mi g.yo gtun khung gzig dang khwa da'i mgo /rta mgrin gtum mo byi la pu shud mgo /gzhan gyi mi thub mda' skems spyang khra'i mgo /'khyil pa sgra mdzad seṅge pha waṃ mgo /khams gsum gsod ma dred dang sbre mong mgo /stobs chen rig byed dom dang byi ba'i mgo

/gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gso byed ma/ /dngos grub mchog stsol ye shes chen po'i dngos/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i bka' bsrung dam chen tshogs/ /phrin las bzhi sgrub dam tshig rjes spyod pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /rigs lnga khro bcu sgo ma rnam pa bzhi/ /bgegs 'dul byang chub sems kyi dngos la bstod// pa gnyis bsdus pa bzhin bya'o/ /bzlas pa'i skabs su/ hūm̐ badzra dzña na kī li kī la ya zhes brjod dus/ rang gi snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' las/ de dang 'dra ba yum med gcig mdun du bye nas rang la zhal phyogs par bzhugs/ dzña na sa twa e tri ko ṇa ……bi ma na/ pa padma maṇḍa la/ ma sūrya maṇḍa la/ a tsant+ra maṇḍa la/ hūm̐ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs brjod dus/ rang gi snying gar gru gsum mthing nag gi dbus su padma nyi zla'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra yum med pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyi hūm̐ sngon po yungs 'bru tsam gyi mthar kī la ya'i sngags kha dog sngon po skra shad kyi bris pa lta bu g.yas bskor du bsam nas/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang phyug pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng nas/ /bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /yab yum thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med/ /'khor gyi khra men pho nya'i tshogs la sogs/ /yun ring dus nas bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i lha/ /drag po rang byung dbang dang dngos grub rtsol/ /……gru gsum mthing nag sogs rgyas pa bzhin brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las sngags 'phreng kha dog sngon po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba lcags sgrog sbrel ba lta bu rdo rje'i dbus rwa nas byung /

/ye shes sems dpa' dang rang gi sna bug g.yas nas phyir thon/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa'i sna bug g.yon nas zhugs de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ yang de las sngags phreng byung / mdun gyi sna bug g.yas nas thon/ rang dang ye shes sems dpa'i sna bug g.yon nas zhugs rdo rje'i dbus rwa nas song / rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam zhing / sngags 'phreng phyir 'gro dus de las rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang / bgegs dang bar chod thams cad zhi bar byas sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gyur/ sngags phreng nang du 'ong dus sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma yi dam thams cad kyi byin rlabs rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur byas nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis rlabs/ rang gi sngags brjod pa'i tshe ……kī la ya mdun gyi bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor bla ma yi dam nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa rnams dang / sems can yi dam gyi skur gyur pa thams cad kyis rang gi sngags bzla grogs byed par bsam zhing / sngags phreng rgyun mi chad par 'khor ba la sems gtad pa ni man ngag dam pa yin no/ /bzlas 'phro 'jog pa na yum gyi sngags ci rigs pa dang / oṃ dīpta tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ma rakmo/ yakmo/ kā ma ru pa snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ snying la khril khril/ srog la chum chum/ tsitta srog la tuṃ tuṃ/ thum ril ril/ snying khrag srog la shan shan/ snying tshag tshag 'ur 'ur/ shig shig gul gul/ nyag nyag sod sod/ dha ti/ ma ma shī ghrāṃ/ karma ka ra mā ra se na/ pra marda ni hūm̐ phaṭa/……ma rakmo sogs gzhi snying gcig tu dril ba cung zad bzlas la lag pa thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du phreng ba bcug nas kha rlangs phog par byas la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi sgo nas byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/

bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang / tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas nas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang nyid bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ de nas sgeg 'phreng sogs kyi phyi mchod dang / rang byung 'dod nas dag pa yin/ /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /bzhes te kun tu dgyes mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal tu gsol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī ka pa la bandha ……rang byung gdod nas sogs shlau ka gcig gi mthar mahā pañtsa a mṛ ta sogs kyi nang mchod phul nas/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /mi bzad dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /zhe sdang thugs mchog yakṣa he ru ka /ye shes khro bo che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes dang / lha tshogs 'khor bcas ma lus kun/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang / /ki la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /de nas gur zhal sogs chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul ……sngar nas 'bul bzhin pa yin na 'dir 'bul ba'am/ yang na thun dang po rnams la/ dkar bdud dam can rnams la phul ba tsam gyis chog pas/ de dag gi gtor ma lag len bzhin bshams pa ……dkar mo ba la zlum gtor dkar po/ bdud rgyal dang phur bsrung la dmar gtor gru gsum re nang mchod chu chang gi sbyangs la/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs kyi bsangs/ 'di man gong bdud rtsi dang gtor ma byin rlabs bzhin/……swa bha was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung sogs phur pa'i gtor ma byin rlabs ltar byas rjes 'bru gsum brjod pas byin gyis rlabs/ de nas gtor ma 'bul tshul sogs logs su bshad pa bzhin bya/

thun tha ma'i mjug tu yi dam kye rdor sogs dang lhan cig gtor ma 'bul na/ gtor ma byin rlabs kye rdor bzhin byas pas chog gi/ gzhan byin rlabs zur du mi dgos/ de rjes ye shes lnga ldan ……ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyis/ /'khor lo rab bskor zhi khro'i skur ston pa/ /thugs dam bzhin du bdag la rtser dgongs nas/ /drag po'i stobs kyi dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /sogs kyi dngos grub blang / he ru ka'i yig brgya ……ye ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang / spyi dang mthun ……ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyi lhag chad kha bskangs nas rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs/ med pa la gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang mthun par bya zhing / oṃ shrī badzra ku ma ra kro dha rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kā wa tse hūm̐ phaṭa/……shrī badzra ku ma ra kro dha rakṣa dang / kā wa tse lus bsrung zhing go cha bgo dge ba 'di yi mtha' yas sems can kun/……bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig /sogs kyi bsngo ba dang / skye med chos sku'i sogs kyis ……skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /thugs dam dbang gi gzugs kyi skur sprul ba/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyis/ /skye shi med pa'i don gyi bkra shis shog/ bkra shis rnams skabs dang sbyar la bya'o/ /thun tha ma la bsrung ma rnams kyi gtor ma phul rjes bstod pa byas la 'gyogs gtor phul nas/ ye shes lnga ldan man chod bya zhing / dus rgyun du bsnyen pa byed tshul 'di tsam gyi chog la/ skabs su dus bzang ba rnams dang / bsnyen pa thon rjes tshogs lhag ma bstan bskyong rnams kyang longs skabs dang mthun pa rgyas bsdus gang grub bya/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni stod las byang chub bsgrub pa la ni tshad med la/

smad las dgra bgegs bsgrol ba'i dbang du byas na kī la ya la yi ge srog can bcu drug yod pas 'bru 'bum gyis 'bum phrag bcu drug de'i kha skong khri tsho bcu drug stong phrag bcu drug rnams bzlas nas bsnyen pa'i mthar kha skong gi sbyin sreg ni zhi ba'i sbyin sreg spyi dang mthun zhing / grangs ni rdzas til lam/ yungs kar gang rung dang sngags kī la ya kho na la grangs bzung nas skabs su/ sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shantiṃ ku ru swahā/ zhes spel tshig can ci rigs bya/ bsnyen pa'i dus kyang kī la ya kho na la sngags kyi grangs bzung bas chog gi/ gzhan yum dang 'khor rnams la bsnyen pa zur du mi dgos par phur pa'i yi ge rnying pa las bshad pas phyag len yang gong du bkod pa 'di kho na la mdzad pa bzhin yid gnyis the tshom mi za ba'i tshul gyis bsgrub pa la zhugs na/ yi dam 'di nyid phrin las kyi lha yin pas sgrub thag nye zhing / khyad par bka' srol brgyud pa rnams la bsnyen bsgrub kyi dus bar chad mi 'byung bar myong bas grub cing / de yang bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs kyi rtags mtshan thob pa sha stag yin pas 'di lta bu'i bsnyen bsgrub mthar phyin na gnas skabs su yi dam gzhan gyi'ang gegs sel bogs 'don du 'gyur la/ mthar thug bslu ba med pa/ rdo rje 'chang sku lnga'i rang bzhin du nges par 'gyur ro/ /ma nor brgyud pa gnyis las legs 'ong pa'i/ /shin tu zab pa'i man ngag gnad 'di dag /snyigs dus blo dman rnams kyi yul min yang / /gzhan la phan pa'i sems kyis 'di bris pas/ /dge ba dri med gang des skye rgu kun/ /'khrul med dam pa'i rjes su rab zhugs te/ /yang dag lam la brtson pa lhur blang nas/ /dpal ldan kun tu bzang po nyid gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen bsgrub byed tshul yi ge rnying pa rnams su cung zad mi gsal ba gsal bar bya ba'i phyir/

bla ma'i man ngag gi brgyan te/ mi'i dbang po sgrol ma rab brtan dpal bzang pos bkas bskul ba bzhin/ dpal sa skya paṇḍi ta shākya'i dge slong 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sgrol byed kyi lo nag pa zla ba'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus nyi shu lnga la/ dpal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rnam dpyod ldan pa zla ba grags pas bris pa'o// //i daṃ sarba satwa sya hi to bha wantu// //'dis kha 'phangs rnams sa skya pa ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis mchan du bris pa'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 12 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ dpal rdo rje phur pa'i bsnyen sgrub kyi gsal byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
